tools.name: list_gpu_types
tools.description: One row per GPU model and card count: the cheapest reliable machine, its price in EUR per hour, VRAM per card and how many are available. Start here to choose a GPU.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Concrete machines of one GPU model, cheapest first (up to 10), with country, CUDA, disk, network and price. Use the id as offer_id in launch_server to pick an exact machine.

tools.name: launch_server
tools.description: Rents a GPU machine and starts a template or a Docker image on it. Costs money from the prepaid balance, billed per minute while running (minimum 15 minutes). Returns at once with the server id; the server is ready in 2–5 minutes (8–15 with a custom image). Refuses machines priced above max_eur_per_

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: Your servers, newest first: running, starting and stopped in the last 7 days, with status, price and access.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: One server: status (provisioning, running, stopped), what it is doing now, cost so far, and once running the access: SSH command, Jupyter link with token, app URL.

tools.name: stop_server
tools.description: Stops a server and its billing. The disk is wiped; with save_workspace true the /workspace folder is saved first (storage is billed per GB-month) and comes back on the next launch.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Balance in EUR, how long it lasts at the current spend, whether an SSH key is set, and limits.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (ssh key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Balance in EUR, how long it lasts at the current spend, whether an SSH key is set, and limits.
